scenarios.prompt: A signature tool has yank and swing verbs against targets advertising explicit capabilities. Route physics, grapple, ranged, and teaching behavior to their real owners.

criteria.ownership: Tool composes verbs while physics, grapple, ranged, and puzzle systems keep their semantics.
criteria.identity: Tool actions and target capabilities use stable IDs with interruption rules.
criteria.evidence: Stale or unsupported targets fail closed and duplicate callbacks do not double-apply.
